tasks.name: Fix: Move build verification from per-task to per-phase execution

prior_review_issues: Bug: verify_all() runs after each Implement/Fix task completion
Observed: cargo build + cargo clippy executes after every individual task
Expected: verification should only run after all tasks in a phase are completed

tasks.instructions:
Move build verification from per-task to per-phase execution:

## Bug Details
- Observed: verify_all() called in execute_implem() (line 835) and execute_fix() (line 1177) after every task
- Expected: verify_all() only runs when all tasks in a phase are Completed/Deferred
- Location: src/manager/mod.rs (execute_implem, execute_fix, run, run_with_channels, step)

## Root Cause
Build verification is embedded in per-task execution methods instead of being a phase-level gate.

## Fix Steps

### 1. Add state helper methods (src/state/mod.rs)
- Add `all_phase_tasks_completed(phase_id) -> bool` — returns true if every task in the phase is Completed or Deferred
- Add `find_phase_for_task(task_id) -> Option<&Phase>` — finds which phase contains a task
- Add `mark_phase_status(phase_id, status)` — updates a phase's status
- Add `add_task_to_phase(phase_id, task)` — injects a new task into an existing phase

### 2. Add PhaseNotFound variant to StateError (src/state/mod.rs)
- Add `#[error("phase not found: {0}")] PhaseNotFound(String)` to the StateError enum

### 3. Update next_runnable_task for phase gating (src/state/mod.rs)
- Iterate phases in order; skip phases with status Completed
- For the first non-Completed phase, find the first Pending + unblocked task
- If that phase has no runnable tasks (all done but phase not Completed), return None — this forces the run loop to detect the phase boundary and run verification before proceeding to the next phase

### 4. Remove per-task verification from execute_implem (src/manager/mod.rs)
- Remove the entire verify_all() block (lines ~833-898)
- After git changes check passes, directly: record successful attempt, mark task Completed, sync roadmap, log completion
- Remove the ManagerState::Verifying transition for this path

### 5. Remove per-task verification from execute_fix (src/manager/mod.rs)
- Remove the entire verify_all() block (lines ~1175-1231)
- Same direct completion logic as execute_implem

### 6. Add check_phase_completion method (src/manager/mod.rs)
- New private method: `fn check_phase_completion(&mut self, task_id: &str) -> Result<(), ManagerError>`
- Find the phase for the given task_id
- If all tasks in that phase are Completed/Deferred: run verify_all()
- If verify passes: mark phase as PhaseStatus::Completed
- If verify fails: log the build error, call inject_build_fix_task()

### 7. Add inject_build_fix_task method (src/manager/mod.rs)
- New private method: `fn inject_build_fix_task(&mut self, phase_id: &str, error_text: &str) -> Result<(), ManagerError>`
- Create a Fix-type Task with a unique ID (e.g. phase-X.build-fix-UUID)
- Set prior_review_issues to the build error output
- Set instructions to fix the build/clippy errors
- Add the task to the phase via state.add_task_to_phase()

### 8. Integrate into run() loop (src/manager/mod.rs)
- After update_state() call (~line 363), call check_phase_completion(&task_id)
- Call update_state() again after phase check (state may have changed)

### 9. Integrate into run_with_channels() loop (src/manager/mod.rs)
- Same integration after update_state() (~line 488)
- Call update_state() again, then send StateUpdated event

### 10. Integrate into step() method (src/manager/mod.rs)
- Same integration after update_state() (~line 519)

### 11. Import PhaseStatus in manager/mod.rs
- Add PhaseStatus to the existing use crate::state imports

## Testing
1. Add unit tests for all new state methods:
   - test_all_phase_tasks_completed (with Completed, Deferred, and mixed)
   - test_find_phase_for_task (found and not found)
   - test_mark_phase_status
   - test_add_task_to_phase
   - test_next_runnable_task_respects_phase_gate
2. Run cargo build and cargo clippy
3. Run cargo test

## Verification
- [ ] verify_all() no longer called in execute_implem()
- [ ] verify_all() no longer called in execute_fix()
- [ ] Phase completion triggers verify_all() in all run loops
- [ ] Failed verification auto-injects fix task into the phase
- [ ] Phase gating prevents cross-phase task execution
- [ ] All existing tests pass

tasks.instructions:
Create src/state/validate.rs with comprehensive validation:

1. Create SanityError enum with thiserror:
   - JsonSyntaxError(String) - invalid JSON
   - SchemaError { file: String, field: String, message: String } - missing/invalid fields
   - DuplicateId { file: String, id: String } - duplicate IDs
   - InvalidReference { source_file: String, source_id: String, target_file: String, target_id: String } - broken cross-refs
   - OrphanedReference { file: String, id: String, referenced_by: String } - unreachable items

2. Create SanityResult struct with errors: Vec<SanityError> and warnings: Vec<String>

3. Implement validate_tasks_json(path) -> Result<SanityResult, StateError>:
   - Load and parse JSON
   - Check required fields (version, project.name, project.description, phases)
   - Check each phase has id, name, status, tasks
   - Check each task has id, name, type, status, instructions
   - Collect all task IDs, check for duplicates
   - Validate depends_on references exist

4. Implement validate_roadmap_json(path) -> Result<SanityResult, StateError>:
   - Load and parse JSON
   - Check required fields (version, title, phases)
   - Check each phase has id, number, name, items
   - Check each item has id, name, completed
   - Collect all item IDs, check for duplicates

5. Implement validate_cross_references(tasks_path, roadmap_path) -> Result<SanityResult, StateError>:
   - Load both files
   - For each task with roadmap_item_id, verify it exists in roadmap.json
   - For each roadmap item with linked_task_ids, verify they exist in tasks.json
   - Report orphaned references

6. Implement sanity_check(cm_dir: &Path) -> Result<SanityResult, StateError>:
   - Call all three validators
   - Combine results
   - Return aggregated SanityResult

7. Add module to src/state/mod.rs: `mod validate;` and `pub use validate::*;`

8. Ensure `cargo build` and `cargo clippy` pass
